description: Export the document as Adobe PDF (Print) with any option of the Export Adobe PDF dialog: General, Compression, Marks and Bleeds, Output (with Ink Manager), Advanced and Security, optionally starting from a preset and exporting in the background (File > Export > Adobe PDF (Print))

advanced.description: Advanced panel (fonts, OPI, transparency flattener, accessibility)

appliedFlattenerPreset.description: Transparency Flattener preset name, e.g. "[Medium Resolution]"

defaultDocumentLanguage.description: Language, as InDesign names it, e.g. "English: USA"

pdfDisplayTitle.description: Display Title: document title or file name

subsetFontsBelow.description: Subset fonts when percent of characters used is less than

background.description: Export in the background (Background Tasks panel) and return the task; follow it with background_exports

colorBitmapSamplingDPI.description: Color Images: downsample to this resolution (ppi)

grayscaleBitmapSamplingDPI.description: Grayscale Images: downsample to this resolution (ppi)

monochromeBitmapSamplingDPI.description: Monochrome Images: downsample to this resolution (ppi)

thresholdToCompressColor.description: Color Images: for images above this resolution (ppi)

thresholdToCompressGray.description: Grayscale Images: for images above this resolution (ppi)

thresholdToCompressMonochrome.description: Monochrome Images: for images above this resolution (ppi)

filePath.description: Output PDF file path (inside the allowed directories)

acrobatCompatibility.description: Compatibility (Acrobat 4 / PDF 1.3 up to Acrobat 8 / PDF 1.7)

exportAsSinglePages.description: Create Separate PDF Files, one per page or spread

exportGuidesAndGrids.description: Include Visible Guides and Baseline Grids

exportReaderSpreads.description: Export spreads instead of single pages (Pages / Spreads)

singlePagesPDFSuffix.description: File name suffix for separate PDF files

standardsCompliance.description: Standard (PDF/X); set before the options it constrains

inkManager.description: Ink Manager (Output panel): convert spot inks to process or alias them. These are document settings and stay after the export, as in InDesign

aliasInkName.description: Ink Alias: print this ink as another ink

convertToProcess.description: Convert this spot ink to process

keepSettings.description: Leave the settings in place after the export, as the dialog does (default: put the previous settings back)

pageMarksOffset.description: Offset of the marks from the page edge (mm)

printerMarkWeight.description: Weight of printer's marks (0.125, 0.25 or 0.5 pt)

pdfColorSpace.description: Color Conversion (REPURPOSE_ values convert to the destination preserving numbers)

pdfDestinationProfile.description: Destination profile. USE_DOCUMENT, USE_MONITOR_PROFILE, USE_NO_PROFILE, WORKING, or a colour profile name

pdfXProfile.description: PDF/X Output Intent Profile Name. USE_DOCUMENT, USE_MONITOR_PROFILE, USE_NO_PROFILE, WORKING, or a colour profile name

pages.description: Pages: "all", or page names as in the Pages panel such as "1-3,5"; prefix + for absolute positions ("+1-+3")

preset.description: Start from this PDF export preset, e.g. "[High Quality Print]" or "[PDF/X-4:2008]"; the options below override it (default: the current settings)

security.description: Security panel. Passwords are written into the PDF and never returned

changeSecurityPassword.description: Use a Password to Restrict Printing, Editing and Other Tasks: the permissions password

disallowCopying.description: Turn off Enable Copying of Text, Images and Other Content

disallowDocumentAssembly.description: Changes Allowed: no inserting, deleting or rotating pages

disallowExtractionForAccessibility.description: Turn off Enable Text Access of Screen Reader Devices

disallowFormFillIn.description: Changes Allowed: no filling in form fields

disallowPrinting.description: Printing Allowed: none (with disallowHiResPrinting false, low resolution printing is allowed)

openDocumentPassword.description: Require a Password to Open the Document: the document open password

useSecurity.description: Turn on PDF security (needed for the options below)

name: export_pdf_with_options
title: Export PDF With Options
